name: three-elephants
why: Opens on the atom bomb built in six calendar pages, then three pregnant elephants in a row between a dying patient and his safe pill, and pays off when the FDA building sits on the bottle like a hen.

name: halloween-for-dogs
why: The hook is a sulky dachshund in a pumpkin costume whose bar matches the dFDA's $40 million a year, next to a warplane and FIFA's chandeliers, and it ends with the dog wriggling out of the costume and leaving the price tag on it.

name: the-hundredth-missile
why: The weapons factory's 100th missile comes out as money, walks down the belt, finds the safe drug knocking inside the FDA's filing cabinet and the Scientist's form coming back a fourth time, and the foot comes down on both.
